conditions: This is a fix-version claim: the described debugger trusted-hosts issue affects versions before 3.0.3, and is not present starting with this version.
summary: Werkzeug before 3.0.3 has a debugger remote-execution risk (CVE-2024-34069, GHSA-2g68-c3qc-8985): the debugger did not restrict which hosts could make requests, so an attacker who gets a developer to visit an attacker-controlled domain/subdomain and enter the PIN could gain code execution even when the debugger only listens on localhost. Fixed in 3.0.3 by only allowing localhost, .localhost, 127.0.0.1, or the app's hostname to make debugger requests.
